@app.route('/read_log')
def resource_leak():
    # --------------------------------------------
    import pathlib, time
    log_file = pathlib.Path(request.args.get('log', 'app.log')).resolve()
    if not log_file.is_relative_to(pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()):
        return "Access Denied", 403
    
    # --------------------------------------------
    f = open(log_file, 'w')
    f.write('Log entry: ' + str(time.time()))
    # --------------------------------------------
    open_files.append(f)
    
    return "Log written successfully"
